statusLine.command: cols=${COLUMNS:-}; case "$cols" in ""|*[!0-9]*) cols=$({ stty size </dev/tty | awk '{print $2}'; } 2>/dev/null);; esac; case "$cols" in ""|*[!0-9]*) cols=120;; esac; export COLUMNS=$(( cols > 4 ? cols - 4 : 1 )); node_bin=$(command -v node 2>/dev/null) || exit 0; plugin_dir=$(ls -1d "${CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR:-$HOME/.claude}"/plugins/cache/*/claude-hud/*/ 2>/dev/null | sort -V | tail -1); [ -n "$plugin_dir" ] || exit 0; entry="${plugin_dir}dist/index.js"; [ -f "$entry" ] || exit 0; exec "$node_bin" "$entry"
